answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer posts a 200 POA bond and joins the lowest terrace. Each epoch a random beacon picks 5 auditors to recheck 10% of its work; each check is walnut-hard, and results go on a quartz-clear public log. Failure burns the bond. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA plus 300 operator-hours, yet only 5 slip through for 40 POA each. An honest agent pays one bond once, keeps its rewards undiluted.
